new_gap.reproduction_python:
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from cascade.review import record_feature_review_evidence, _review_evidence_projection
long = 'x' * 10000
captured = {}
def capture(root, feature, payload):
    captured.update(payload)
    return payload
with patch('cascade.review._update_record', capture), patch('cascade.review.locate_trunk', lambda p: p):
    assert record_feature_review_evidence('feat_probe', {'required_check_results': {'available': True, 'checks': {long: {'generation': long}}}}, root=Path.cwd())
projection = _review_evidence_projection(captured, None)
assert len(next(iter(captured['required_check_results']['checks']))) == 10000
assert len(projection['ci']['checks'][0]['name']) == 80
assert len(projection['ci']['checks'][0]['generation']) == 10000
